srList.sentence: Clinical notes, operative reports, and MRI scans of adult patients younger than 40 years of age who had sustained noncontact unilateral ACL rupture during soccer (soccer group) or basketball (basketball group) were reviewed to determine the detailed injury information.

srList.sentence: A 2 x 2 analysis of variance (ANOVA) with a mixed design was performed to compare the specific bone bruise locations in the lateral-medial direction in patients with the LF+LT pattern, between groups (soccer and basketball groups) and between bones (femur and tibia), for the tibia and the femur.
